intro: Other people’s secrets cannot escape the detective’s attention.
description:
Having gained a reputation as a man versed in the occult, Detective Woodbrey has attracted a rather peculiar clientele. Whether that is good or bad is for you to decide!

“Mystery Detective Adventure 2” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

The world does not stand still—and neither does the world of crime. Thieves and murderers are becoming ever more cunning and twisted. And while others argue over who should make the streets safe and life fair, Detective John Woodbrey takes action, no matter what.
His experience played a cruel joke on him: he failed his last case after becoming too absorbed in paranormal phenomena and losing touch with reality. But his respite will not last forever—retirement is still a long way off.
With a reputation as a detective versed in the occult, he finds mystic cases drawn to him. He will have to undertake three investigations—three unique and dangerous adventures. Their unpredictable nature will force you to find solutions on the fly and quickly adapt to the situation. There will be no time to be bored!

- Close extraordinary cases that only you can handle.
- Each investigation tells its own story, with unique locations and characters.
- Complete collections by studying the world carefully and missing none of even the smallest details.
- Examine locations carefully and find every collectible
- Join the battle for freedom alongside your favorite characters
